2609.17251.title: Persistent Recurrent Memory Between Transformer Layers - Improves Language Model Generalization
2609.17251.paper_summary: We introduce a simple architectural modification to decoder-only transformers: a persistent recurrent state that observes hidden representations via cross-attention, updates itself through a GRU, and modulates subsequent processing via gated addition. Inserted between the lower and upper halves of a 6-layer transformer, this module adds only 3.7\% additional parameters while reducing evaluation loss from $2.438 \pm 0.004$ to $1.743 \pm 0.018$, corresponding to a 28.5\% reduction on held-out language modeling data. The improvement is statistically significant across 5 random seeds ($p < 0.01$) and corresponds to reduced overfitting (generalization gap 0.12 vs 0.26). Through controlled ablations, we demonstrate that the improvement stems entirely from the persistent memory topology, not from auxiliary self-prediction objectives. A model with identical topology but no auxiliary loss performs equivalently, while a random auxiliary loss provides no benefit. Representation probing reveals that the persistent state encodes narrative position (52\% vs 33\% chance level)---information that standard attention maintains less efficiently. Our results suggest that bridging transformer layers with a lightweight recurrent memory is a simple, effective approach to improving generalization in small-scale language models.
2609.17251.paper_summary_zh: 我們對僅解碼器的Transformer提出了一個簡單的架構修改：一個持久的遞迴狀態，通過交叉注意觀察隱藏表示，通過GRU自我更新，並通過閘控加法調節後續處理。這個模組插入在6層Transformer的下半部和上半部之間，只增加了3.7\%的額外參數，同時將評估損失從$2.438 \pm 0.004$降低到$1.743 \pm 0.018$，對應於在保留的語言建模數據上減少了28.5\%。這一改進在5個隨機種子上具有統計學意義（$p < 0.01$），並對應於減少的過擬合（泛化差距0.12對比0.26）。通過控制性消融，我們證明這一改進完全源於持久記憶拓撲，而非輔助自我預測目標。具有相同拓撲但沒有輔助損失的模型表現相當，而隨機的輔助損失則沒有提供任何好處。表示探測顯示，持久狀態編碼敘事位置（52\%對比33\%的機會水平）——這一信息是標準注意力維持得不那麼高效。我們的結果表明，通過輕量級的遞迴記憶橋接Transformer層是一種簡單有效的方法，可以改善小規模語言模型的泛化能力。
2609.17251.author: Eduardo Novaes Hering et.al.
